en.topic_title: Sai Kung’s Po Pin Chau trail fully booked ahead of upcoming holidays, as Hong Kong expects 1.3m mainland visitors
en.topic_summary:
Sai Kung’s popular Po Pin Chau trail has been fully booked for part of the upcoming National Day holiday, when Hong Kong expects to see some 1.3 million arrivals from mainland China over the weeklong vacation.



Po Pin Chau. Photo: AFCD. 



The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said in a Facebook post on Thursday that no available time slots are left for the High Island Geo Trail – Po Pin Chau Section on Friday and Saturday next week.
